📉 Killeen Housing Market Just Hit a New Record Low — What It Means for Buyers & Sellers
In this video, I break down why May 2025 had the lowest number of home sales in Killeen in nearly a decade — and what that means if you're trying to buy or sell in Central Texas. Spoiler: affordability is a major issue, and buyer behavior is shifting fast.

🏡 I’ll walk you through real market data for Killeen, Copperas Cove, Temple, Belton, Nolanville, Salado, and Harker Heights — including:

✅ Median sales prices
✅ Price drops and days on market
✅ Buyer vs. seller market index
✅ What you can actually buy at the median price
✅ The “magic number” every buyer and seller needs to know right now: 96.1% (close-to-original list price ratio)

📦 PLUS: See side-by-side comparisons of new construction vs resale homes, and how I helped one of my sellers get multiple offers in 24 hours in the slowest market we've seen in years.

🎯 Whether you're trying to buy smart or sell for top dollar, this update is for you.

We'll break down your local market, run the numbers, and give you a game plan tailored to YOU.

June 2025 Housing Report: Killeen, Fort Cavazos, Harker Heights, Belton, Temple, Salado, Nolanville
Thinking about buying or selling a home in the Killeen-Temple area? In this video, I break down real housing data from  Killeen, Fort Cavazos, Harker Heights, Belton, Temple, Salado, Nolanville, and show you exactly what’s going on in today’s market. 📉📈

From price drops to hot neighborhoods like Bella Charca, we’ll look at what your money actually gets you — and reveal the “magic number” every buyer and seller should know in 2025 (hint: it's 4%). Whether you're investing, relocating, or just curious, this video will give you a clear picture of what’s happening on the ground in Central Texas!
